mutants.title: Cart total skips the last item
mutants.userImpact: Customer is charged less than the items in the cart: the last line item is left out of the subtotal and total

mutants.title: "+" quantity button does nothing
mutants.userImpact: Customer cannot increase the quantity of an item with the + button

mutants.title: Code SAVE10 takes 1% off instead of 10%
mutants.userImpact: Customer gets a much smaller discount than SAVE10 promises

mutants.title: Shipping fee not added on orders under $50
mutants.userImpact: Shop loses the $5.00 shipping fee on small orders; total is $5.00 too low

mutants.title: Checkout accepts an email without a domain (a@)
mutants.userImpact: Orders are placed with an email address nobody can reply to

mutants.title: "Remove" deletes the first item, not the clicked one
mutants.userImpact: Customer clicks Remove on one item and a different item disappears

mutants.title: Out-of-stock product can still be added to cart
mutants.userImpact: Customer can order the Wool Beanie, which is out of stock

mutants.title: Order confirmation shows a blank order number
mutants.userImpact: Customer has no order number to quote to support

mutants.title: Login redirects to Home instead of Account
mutants.userImpact: After signing in the customer lands on the home page, not My account

mutants.title: Cart empties on page refresh (state not saved)
mutants.userImpact: Customer loses everything in the cart when the page reloads

mutants.title: Cart badge counts distinct products instead of total quantity
mutants.userImpact: The header cart badge shows how many different products are in the cart, not how many items. Adding the same product twice still shows 1, so shoppers lose track of how many items they have.
mutants.kaneCheck: Open the home page at http://localhost:4173 and click the 'Add to cart' button for Canvas Tote once. Then click the 'Add to cart' button for Canvas Tote a second time. Open the cart page at /cart and confirm Canvas Tote is listed with quantity 2. Verify the cart badge in the header shows 1 (instead of 2).

mutants.title: Free-shipping threshold checks the subtotal before the discount
mutants.userImpact: An order whose subtotal is $50 or more but drops below $50 after SAVE10 wrongly gets free shipping, so the customer is undercharged by $5.00.
mutants.kaneCheck: Open http://localhost:4173. On the home page, add the Canvas Tote to the cart, then add the Desk Plant to the cart. Open the cart page at /cart and verify the Subtotal shows $54.98. Enter the discount code SAVE10 and click Apply. Verify the Discount shows −$5.50, Shipping shows Free and the Total shows $49.48.

mutants.title: Sign out leaves the customer signed in
mutants.userImpact: After pressing "Sign out" on the account page, the header still shows "Signed in as demo@saboteur.shop", so the customer appears to still be logged in until they refresh the page.
mutants.kaneCheck: Open http://localhost:4173/login and sign in with email "demo@saboteur.shop" and password "sabotage123". On the My account page, press the "Sign out" button. Do not reload the page. You should land on the home page product grid. Verify the header still shows "Signed in as demo@saboteur.shop" and does not show a "Sign in" link.
